edition_scope: The reviewed model dimensions are the 2012 edition, not a claim of conformity to the technically revised 2025 edition. The archived CSN 02 1492 dimensions remain separate source evidence, not relabeled ISO dimensions.
representation_decision: On 2026-10-20 the user replaced the proposed steel-plus-PA6 Assembly with a single steel Part. An ordinary second Body represents the insert symbolically in blue. Both Bodies use the document's steel density; the resulting mass is explicitly a homogeneous-steel approximation, not the physical two-material product mass. No document format or per-Body material extension is needed.
selected_cad_details: The manufacturer-defined prevailing-torque feature is represented by a rounded retaining collar and a symbolic annulus. Collar outside radius is 0.46s, wall is 0.3P, lip thickness is 0.2P, outside corner radius is 0.125P, lip bore radius is D/2+0.15P and insert bore radius is D/2-0.1P. These are declared nominal CAD choices, not additional normative dimensions or a simulation of insertion, crimping or prevailing torque. Bottom seating is Z=0; there is no raised washer face. Selected outer bevel is 30 degrees and thread mouth is 120 degrees. Cosmetic threads follow the existing native catalog.
